text:
inc-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx and timeouts observed for /v1/stream in prod-us-west — incident INC-34195 created, severity: P1
ops-bot: paging oncall: ravi
ravi (oncall): ack. looking at grafana and gateway logs. errors started ~3419997600. predominantly 502/504 and request timeouts.
nora (runtime): grabbing model-runner logs now. seeing repeated fatal: "illegal instruction (SIGILL)" in runner process. also multiple NVML resets on node gpu-pool-7.
marta (eng-sre): confirmed NVML GPU resets and kernel messages: OOM not always present but driver resets happening. linking logs:

nora (runtime): ```
[2026-04-02T02:40:11Z] FATAL model-runner: uncaught SIGILL in fused_attn_kernel.cu: instruction 0x7f..
[2026-04-02T02:40:11Z] kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=12345 GPU at 0000:65:00:00
[2026-04-02T02:40:12Z] gateway: upstream 10.10.21.11:8080 returned 502 after 1.2s
```

dan (platform): cordoning gpu-pool-7 and draining pods now: `kubectl cordon gpu-pool-7 && kubectl drain gpu-pool-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
dan (platform): provisioning spare nodes from warm pool and increasing autoscaler max. provisioning ETA ~6m.

ravi (oncall): mitigation plan: (A) take affected node out, (B) flip traffic to fallback model redwood-medium-fallback, (C) disable fused-attn kernel flag on runtime to force safe path, (D) enforce request token cap for long contexts. Who can apply B/C now?
nora (runtime): I can push runtime flag: `--use-fused-attn=false` as a quick restart for runners, also will push gateway routing for fallback. doing a rolling restart in prod-us-west with concurrency 2.
marta (eng-sre): I'll reduce default batch size to 1 for the gptx-family in us-west and add a temporary guard rejecting requests with tokens>8000.

ops-bot: route-change rc-34199-1 applied: redirect 70% traffic to redwood-medium-fallback for model_family==gptx region==us-west
ops-bot: runner flag change initiated: rollout rf-34199-1

lia (customer-success): notifying major EU/US accounts affected. drafting status: "We are investigating elevated errors impacting streaming in us-west; mitigation underway."
ben (support): filing support tickets per affected account and linking to internal incident doc: ZD-34901.

nora (runtime): after flag flip and restarts, one node still reporting driver resets but no SIGILL; OOMs are less frequent. running targeted heap/kv-cache instrumentation to capture leak. baseline errors dropped from 22% -> 3.5% over 8 mins.
ravi (oncall): timeline for postmortem:
- 02:39 UTC: alert triggered INC-34195
- 02:40 UTC: oncall ack
- 02:42 UTC: identified driver resets/SIGILL in fused_attn kernel
- 02:44 UTC: cordon/drain gpu-pool-7 and route-change to fallback
- 02:47 UTC: runtime flag `--use-fused-attn=false` rolled out to runners
- 02:55 UTC: error rate falls to ~3% and stabilizes

marta (eng-sre): followups: 1) repro in staging with similar hardware; 2) bisect fused-attn merge commits and revert suspect patch; 3) add NVML-driver-reset alert to page faster; 4) add automatic short-circuit to fallback on repeated driver resets per node.
nora (runtime): assigning self for RCA, will include reproducer, coredumps, and test matrices across CUDA driver versions. also will harden runtime to fail safe on kernel exceptions rather than crash whole runner.
ravi (oncall): handing off to nora/marta for RCA and mitigations. I'll draft exec/customer communications and schedule postmortem meeting. current status: mitigated (monitoring). inc-bot: Incident INC-34195 status -> MITIGATED by ravi at 3419998177
